text:
maria: Noticing a weird failure in the sample-app toolcall flow after auth retries. Hits schema validation in prod-like test.
devon: ugh, describe the failure? stack + payload?
maria: minimal failing body from logs: 
```
\"{\"action\":\"lookup_user\",\"params\":{\"id\":\"u-123\"}}\"
```
anya: that looks double-encoded (string containing JSON). Why would auth retry cause that?
maria: digging: our SDK retry wrapper replays original response body when a 401->reauth path happens; it serializes the cached body with JSON.stringify before re-injecting it into the tool pipeline. if body was already stringified by compact-json path, we end up with a string-of-string.
devon: oh no. So zod schema sees a string but expects object. quick fix: detect JSON-like string and JSON.parse before handing to validator?
maria: tried that locally. Works for simple cases, but breaks when the tool legitimately returns a raw string (e.g., freeform notes).
anya: need behavior that preserves intent. Options: 1) add a metadata flag on tool results indicating original type (json/object vs text) in the retry cache; 2) make the retry re-insert the original raw buffer rather than re-serializing; 3) add tolerant parsing in sample-app that only auto-parses if top-level serializer token is a quote and the schema expects object.
devon: option 2 seems safest and minimal. update retry cache to store original body as Buffer/string and a content-type header. then rehydrate exactly.
qa-bot: integration test failed for sample-app/toolcall-roundtrip on PR 598: "double-encoded payload when auth retry". See job: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/jobs/598
maria: I'll prototype 2 and add a unit test that simulates compact-json + auth retry + toolcall. will also add an integration test for plain-text tool outputs so we don't regress.
anya: note for changelog: "SDK retry now preserves original response shape to avoid double-encoding with compact-json".
devon: small follow-up: audit other places that use JSON.stringify in retry paths (webhooks, event replay) — might be same bug.
qa-bot: reminder: add test labels: unit, integration, regression. :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks — pinging when PR is up.
anya: thanks, will review and help shape tests. :+1:
